solution_files.leap.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, but not by 100 unless it divides by 400.
main() {
  if (( $# != 1 )) || [[ ! $1 =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "Usage: leap.sh <year>"
    exit 1
  fi

  local year=$1
  if (( year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0) )); then
    echo "true"
  else
    echo "false"
  fi
}

main "$@"
